title: Find the Sum of Encrypted Integers
summary: Given an array of positive integers, apply a function that replaces each digit in an integer with the largest digit found in that integer.
statement: Given an array of positive integers, apply a function that replaces each digit in an integer with the largest digit found in that integer. Sum the resulting encrypted integers and return the sum.
constraints: Encrypt an integer by replacing every digit with its largest digit.
Preserve the original number of digits.
Return the sum of the encrypted forms of all nums values.
hints: Convert each positive integer to its decimal representation.
Find its maximum digit and repeat it for the original digit count.
Convert that repeated text back to an integer and add it.
Replacement makes every output position equal to that maximum, so this constructs the unique encrypted value.
editorial: Replacement makes every output position equal to that maximum, so this constructs the unique encrypted value.

tests.explanation: Each one-digit value encrypts to itself, totaling six.
